name: prototype
title: Prototype
summary: Answer one design question with throwaway, trivially-runnable code, then record the verdict in its spec or ticket; production edits require a separate implementation scope.

use_when: A design question is hard to settle on paper — state model, logic, or UI direction
Discussion is circling and a cheap concrete artifact would settle it
avoid_when: Building the real thing — use plan-execution or test-driven-development
A quick discussion can settle the question
